capabilities: Seek and play embedded audio or video from timestamp links
Bind timestamps to specific recordings using aliases for multiple embeds
Keep a floating player alive across view changes and page switches
Configure continue, pause, or close behavior when switching pages
Resize the expanded video player while preserving aspect ratio
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also documents manual installation from GitHub releases and states the plugin runs entirely locally with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian embeds audio and video files but has no way to jump to a specific moment from a clickable timestamp in transcript or meeting notes.
summary: Timestamp-link player that seeks and plays embedded audio or video files when clicking MM:SS or HH:MM:SS links in a note.
